heading: Punishment for cheating.
text: Whoever cheats shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to one year, or with fine, or with both.
status_note: The Act is repealed. Kept in India Code's 'Repeal Acts' collection; record title reads 'The Indian Penal Code, 45 of 1860 (Rep., Act 45 of 2023)' (read 2026-11-21)
